headline: Malaysian Palm Oil Futures Drop Over 1% as Chinese Olein Stocks Reach Record High
summary: Bursa Malaysia benchmark palm oil futures fell 1.23% to 4,332 ringgit per ton, extending losses for a third session due to record high palm olein stockpiles in China.
why: Malaysia is the world's second-largest producer and exporter of palm oil products.

impacts.name: Palm Oil Futures
impacts.why: Record high Chinese inventories reduced demand expectations, pulling futures down 1.23%.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Expanding inventories in top importer China depressed palm oil commodity futures.
